rendered: The binary bacterial mixtures were first tested at volumetric ratios of 1:0, 1:4, 1:8, and 0:1[1]. The sensor array told these apart (Fig. 4[2], panels a–c). For the next set of multicomponent mixtures, which covered both binary (A + B) and ternary (A + B + C) combinations, the paper gives a compositional ratio of 1:1:1[3]. These mixtures could also be classified (Fig. 4[4], panels d–f). The full mixture compositions are in the supplementary tables, which are not part of this document.
